italian-reading-11.title: Stress and accents
italian-reading-11.subtitle: Listen for stress and notice the accent mark
italian-reading-11.description: Learn to hear the stressed part of a word and why some words are written with an accent mark.

ir11-p1.translations: It is evening. Marco is in the city and orders a coffee. “Why is it so good?” he asks.

ir11-t1.text: Listen for word stress even when it is not marked in writing.

ir11-t2.text: In città, caffè, and perché, the written accent is on the final vowel.

ir11_q1.question: Which word has a written accent mark?

ir11_q2.question: Which word has an accent written on the final vowel?

ir11_q3.question: What does the written accent help identify in città?
